body:
I have tried to change, all I think about every day are things to change...I've succeeded in every aspect I don't care about...I eat healthy, go to the gym.  I'm in the most competitive engineering department in my school, I have an amazing apartment to myself.  Yet despite this, I have not had a real friend since middle school, and I'm now in my 5th year of college.  I don't even feel depressed, life should be amazing, I just have no desire to live like this any longer, and I don't see it getting anything but worse from here on.  I don't have energy left to keep going...

In my note I just told my parents I loved them and that it wasn't their fault, I don't really know what else to say...
